![](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/crm-ai-features-icon.svg) AI FEATURES

# Let AI unlock the power of   CRM. Spend more time   selling.

Extract more value from the most important sales tool in your tech

stack—your CRM. Insightly CRM’s AI features empower your team to

increase sales efficiency, build a better pipeline, and accelerate deals.

[Request a demo](https://www.insightly.com/demo-request/)

![Let AI unlock the power of CRM](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/ai-crm-hero.png)

## Smarter selling starts with AI—inside your CRM

With AI, it’s easier to tap into your CRM’s value—faster and with less effort. Surface insights, streamline workflows, and

automate the tasks that slow your team down.

![ai-crm-q2-opportunities](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/ai-crm-q2-opportunities.png)

### Build smarter sales strategies.    Create and close more deals, faster.

Strengthen customer relationships with better data

and intel. Use conversational AI and AI-driven insights

to help you prioritize leads, anticipate customers

needs, identify upsell opportunities, and personalize

touchpoints with ease.

![boost-crm-adoption](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/boost-crm-adoption.png)

### Streamline processes.    Boost CRM adoption.

Insightly’s CRM is designed for ease of use—and with

our AI features, it becomes even more seamless.

Streamline record management with conversational AI

to create and update records, and use standardized

entries with smart suggestions to keep data clean.

![crm-accelerate-productivity](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/crm-accelerate-productivity.png)

### Automate the busywork.    Accelerate productivity.

Accelerate productivity and cut down on manual work

with AI-powered automation for data entry, task

creation, and scheduling. Quickly generate email

replies and summaries with generative AI—so your

team can move faster and close more.

## Boost sales efficiency with Insightly’s AI-powered CRM

### Copilot

Boost sales efficiency and CRM adoption by using AI to keep your

data clean, automate repetitive tasks, and focus on the leads that

matter most.

![Copilot](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/crm-copilot.png)

### AI email replies

Click once, and get an AI-generated reply—filled with the right

context from your Insightly CRM. It’s personalized, professional,

and ready to send in seconds.

![AI email replies](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/ai-email-reply.png)

### AI email summaries

Get instant context with smart summaries of past emails,

calls, and notes—pulled from Contacts, Leads,

Organizations, and more.

![ai-email-summaries](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/ai-email-summaries.png)

## Experience Insightly CRM’s AI features for yourself

[Get a demo](https://www.insightly.com/demo-request/)

## How Copilot helps you do less—and get more from your CRM

![Conversational lookup icon](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Conversational-lookup-icon.svg)

### Conversational   lookup

Search contacts, deals, and tasks with

natural language prompts—get instant

summaries and full relationship context

without digging.

![Smart communication assistance icon](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Smart-communication-assistance-icon.svg)

### Smart communication assistance

Automatically draft emails, follow-ups, and

templates based on past conversations—with

AI-suggested next steps to keep deals

moving.

![Streamlined record management icon](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Streamlined-record-management-icon.svg)

### Streamlined record management

Add, update, and link records via chat

—ensuring your CRM data stays

accurate, connected, and up to date.

## Why teams love Insightly Copilot

### Sales leaders

### Sales reps

### Revenue enablement

### Revenue operations

### Watch sales efficiency soar

Strengthen your CRM from the inside out. With Insightly’s AI-powered CRM

and Copilot, you can transform your workflows and turn your CRM into a sales

engine—one that drives real relationships and ROI.

![Sales Leaders](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/sales-leaders.png)

### Make your CRM work for you

Copilot transforms your CRM into a sales assistant—automating repetitive

tasks and surfacing the insights you need to sell smarter and faster.

![Sales Reps](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/sales-reps.png)

### Drive adoption that sticks

Insightly CRM is built for ease-of-use—and Copilot makes it even more

seamless to onboard new hires, reinforce workflows, and create habits that

stick.

![Revenue enablement](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Revenue-enablement.png)

### Streamline at scale

Copilot keeps your CRM data clean and consistent, making it easier to

maintain processes, trust reports, and give every team member the power to

find answers—without a ticket.

![Revenue operations](https://www.insightly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Revenue-operations.png)

## Discover Copilot at your own pace

Watch the on-demand demo to see how Insightly Copilot uses AI to unlock even more value from your CRM.

[Watch the demo](https://www.insightly.com/demo-on-demand/#open-last)

×

The updated policy will be available at [insightly.com/privacy-policy](http://insightly.com/privacy-policy) from that date.
